--consequent on the Asuras not obtaining अमृत for all their labours in the अमृतमथन, war broke out. It was on the seashore and mainly a hand- to-hand fight; description of; at last Indra invoked Hari, who appeared on the scene and on him कालनेमि flung his शूल; with the same weapon Hari flung him down; so also माल्य- van, मालि and सुमालि were put to death. Fight continued till नारद stopped it.

4: M. २४. ३७-8; ७०. २६-32.
Asuras under ह्राद vanquished the Gods after the battle which continued for a hundred divine years. The gods withdrew to the north of the milky ocean and prayed to विष्णु for suc- cour. The latter deluded the Asuras in मायामोह form and the Asuras were defeated.
